summary: FAMILY FITNESS AS (org. no. 977 466 407) is a private limited company (AS) based in Kragerø, in the Brønnøysund registers since 1997-04-21. It is active with no bankruptcy or liquidation registered. Its main activity is NACE 93.130 (Treningssentervirksomhet); it has 35 registered employees. In its 2025 accounts (company level) operating revenue was NOK 6.7 m and net income was NOK 613 651. CEO: Marte Husabø Hansen; board chair: Bjarne Vidar Borgan Paulsen.
